title: What Slim was like to manage and why he left
summary: Slim was cooperative, a heavy drinker, never trouble. Stovall thinks Shaw's money lured him, and says he banked part of Slim's pay.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor
